meta.note: Expectations hand-derived from tpm_hold_scope 0.2.0: scopes counted on paper, closures traced by hand, refusals from the edge-case table and the gate's rule. Every digest is an external sha256sum over the preimage its case shows. Deterministic; no randomness. Both residences MUST reproduce every expect. 0.3.0 adds 21 tier cases (PD-D-5) and 23 decode/ cases (C-MS-5: a JSON {} and [] and an object keyed 0 read as written in both residences); every release_record case carries tier. No earlier answer moves.
